requirements.text: Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++.
Solid understanding of deep learning fundamentals and at least one framework (PyTorch preferred).
Comfortable reading performance data and reasoning about trade-offs between latency, throughput, memory, and accuracy.

ML inference optimization: hands-on experience making deep learning models run faster or cheaper, e.g. quantization (INT8/FP8), pruning/distillation, operator fusion, mixed precision, or compilers and runtimes such as torch.compile, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or TVM.
Experience with video model inference is a huge plus, e.g. optimizing video generation, video diffusion, or world models, or real-time video understanding pipelines.
Research experience in systems or ML, e.g. publications or substantial research projects (MLSys, OSDI/SOSP, CVPR/ICCV, NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR, or similar).
Experience with real-time or latency-critical inference, e.g. on robots or edge/embedded accelerators.
Contributions to open-source ML systems projects.
